features.implemented: Structural affine-log recognition replaces three-point sampling; staged Laurent multiplication retains coefficients that later poles bring below the requested order. features.implemented: Claim::IrreducibleModPrime binds the exact canonical coefficient vector and prime to an independently checked bounded Rabin certificate. Generic predicates/nonzero claims and expression-result publication cannot borrow this authority.
regressions: A genuine polynomial certificate previously proved NonZero(0); this was observed failing before the fix
Direct construction, independent replay, decoding bounds, import/promotion, and identity mutations are checked

features.artifact_compatibility: Old Rabin artifacts carrying generic claims may decode, but replay and verified import/promotion reject them. Regenerate with the exact typed modular claim. Existing other claim encodings and digests are retained.

features.implemented: Native Frobenius squared norms sum squared absolute values. Public norm(None)/norm("fro") remain Frobenius, vector norm(2) is Euclidean, and genuine matrix norm(2) uses the existing singular-value lane plus exact Max selection. Opaque Python entries are refused before native lowering.
regressions: The squared Frobenius norm of [I] is 1
diag(3,4) has Frobenius norm 5 and spectral norm 4
Exact near-tied rational singular values do not rely on binary64 sorting
Pinned empty shapes and original Symbol/custom-class identity are covered by authored public tests

features.implemented: Each monomial can be consumed by only one cancellation pair. A bounded raw traversal preserves exact partial-expression domain obligations, visits every function/power child, rejects nonfinite values, and discharges only narrow independently known finite cases.
regressions: Overlapping pairs previously certified an equality evaluating to 1=2 at x=y=0; observed before the fix
0*log(0)=0 was accepted through the Pythagorean rule; observed before the domain fix
Nested partial powers/functions, malformed function arities, erased poles, and nonfinite arguments are refused in both direct verification and replay
Retained-domain identities and exact ground sec(0)/tan(0) cases still verify
features.scope: The earlier unconditional symbolic sec/tan proof fixture is corrected to require refusal because its poles disappear. Plain unverified simplification is unchanged. This is not a general definedness solver or complete trigonometric normal form.
